faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Quick answers before you write to us

minOrder.q: Is there a minimum order quantity?
minOrder.a: Yes. Every product has its own minimum order in tons, shown on the product page. Orders below it are not accepted.

pickup.a: Choose pickup at checkout and book a time slot at the warehouse. You get a gate code starting with MC- — show it at the gate. You can follow the status (scheduled → loading → ready → picked up) on the My orders page.

delivery.a: Yes, in refrigerated 0–4 °C trucks to the address you enter. Pickup is free; the delivery fee is quoted separately depending on the distance and quantity.

contract.q: How do monthly supply contracts work?
contract.a: Choose a product, monthly tons and a term of 1–24 months — or let the AI assistant draft it for you. The price per ton is fixed for the whole term. After Milcow approves it, an order is created automatically every month and each one is paid separately.

payment.a: By card through Toss Payments. The server checks the amount against the order total before approving. An unpaid order can be paid later from the My orders page.

ai.q: What can the AI assistant do?
ai.a: The chat answers questions using Milcow's own guides (prices, rules, delivery). The contract assistant turns a sentence like "5 t of raw milk every month for 6 months" into a contract draft. Anything it cannot answer, our staff will answer here.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.notice: Milcow is a demo service built as a portfolio project. No real trades or payments take place (Toss Payments runs in test mode). Please do not enter real personal data.
Privacy.intro: Milcow ("the service") respects your privacy and collects only the minimum information needed to provide the service.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.text:
At sign-up: email, password (stored hashed), contact name, company name, business registration number, phone number
While using the service: orders, contracts and pickups, payment records (card numbers are never stored), contact-form messages, AI chat questions

social.title: Social login (Kakao · Google)
social.text: When you log in with Kakao or Google we receive only your email address, name (nickname) and account ID from that provider. We do not request anything else (contacts, friends, etc.).

use.title: How we use it
use.text: Only for login and account management, processing orders, contracts and pickups, confirming payments, answering inquiries, and improving AI answers (question/answer logs). Never for advertising or marketing.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services
thirdParty.text:
Payments: Toss Payments (test mode)
AI chat: Google Gemini API (your question is sent to generate the answer)
Maps: Kakao Map
Hosting: Vercel (web), Render (API), Neon (database)
We do not sell personal data or share it for any other purpose.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We use a single httpOnly cookie (the login token) to keep you signed in. No analytics or advertising cookies. Your language choice may be stored in the browser.

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: Your data is deleted without delay when you delete your account or ask us to. Demo account data is reset every day.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask to view, correct or delete your data at any time using the contact below.
